The tetragonal phase Lu4C6 (reduced formula Lu2C3) crystallizes in space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral carbon centers coordinated by six Lu neighbors, alongside a second carbon environment with four Lu neighbors and Lu centers with ten neighbors (six C, four Lu). Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between C-centered octahedra and between C octahedra and four-vertex C polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between C octahedra and between four-vertex C polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
